Bancroft says entire Australian cricket team knew of ball-tampering

Cameron Bancroft has stated that the entire Australian cricket squad was aware of the ball-tampering scheme during the 2018 "Sandpapergate" scandal. Bancroft admitted that he withheld the full truth during the Cricket Australia investigation to protect other players. His statements have brought renewed attention to the incident.
